body:
Thanks for sending an issue! Please fill in the following template to help quickly solve your problem.

### Describe the current behavior / 问题描述 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
修复gathernd精度问题，ub循环整除情况下，ub尾循环采用求余方式计算逻辑错误
当 gatherSize 是 ubFactor 的整数倍时，ubTail = 0
uint64_t ubTail = gatherSize % ubFactor;  //  若 gatherSize=1024, ubFactor=256, ubTail=0
// ...
dmaSize = (u < (ubLoop - 1)) ? ubFactor : ubTail;  // 最后一次循环 dmaSize=0
修复：
uint64_t ubTail = gatherSize - ubFactor * (ubLoop - 1);

### Environment / 环境信息 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
Ascned950PR
### Steps to reproduce the issue / 重现步骤 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
测试用例((1,3, 2, 4, 5,2,2,4), (0,))
### Describe the expected behavior / 预期结果 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
((1,3, 2, 4, 5,2,2,4), (0,))精度通过
### Related log / screenshot / 日志 / 截图 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
修复前，精度失败：
![image.png](https://raw.gitcode.com/user-images/assets/7665709/ee36c500-a486-49ce-a642-ba50cb185a84/image.png 'image.png')

![image.png](https://raw.gitcode.com/user-images/assets/7665709/696d9cc8-d0ec-4faa-9e22-f8cce571f4ce/image.png 'image.png')
